mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Narrow status fields with large legal dimensions/coordinates and a long import message with recovery details, at scale 1/light and scale 2/dark. Truncation leaves one full explicit hint rather than an automatic raw-text hint plus the explicit one. Hover emits no zoom intentions and zoom control positions stay fixed.

regression_baseline.result: The added unchanged probe failed before the status-label fix: raw field text appeared twice instead of once in the accessibility tree, exposing the extra automatic tooltip. This expected baseline failure is preserved separately from passing current logs.

scope: Classic v11 status metric and message labels disable automatic elision tooltips while retaining their explicit complete tooltips, including recovery details. Layout and document/zoom semantics are unchanged.
limits: The new focused check supplies synthetic presentation facts, not a live document at those dimensions. Existing application status/zoom/document-preservation checks pass in the full suite. Native/rendered visual parity, input latency and broader roadmap completion remain open.
